grid.layout_notes: 4-4-4-4-4 plus Conveyor Belt above and Hot Sauce Reels on far left/right.

win_system.notes: Ways with xSplit (max 4 splits); exact ways count not on CMS.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: Wins/xBomb remove; Conveyor drops into gaps; Hot Sauce triggers before next collapse.

other.name: Hot Sauce Reels
other.how_it_works: Triggered by Wild Launch Button; base fills one side partially/fully each spin; FS both sides. Fire xSplit / xBomb / Multiplier RPG (2–5×, 99×) into Launch Wild.

other.name: Conveyor Belt
other.how_it_works: Wild Launch→Wild Doughnut + Hot Sauce; Wild Doughnut; xNudge Wild Tower (4-high, additive nudge mult); Red Cap→Cap Win Machine; Trash Can dead filler.

other.name: Cap Win Machine
other.how_it_works: Push for Red Cap rows 30×/20×/15×/10× or Yellow Cap Max Win; collect fallen caps × bet.

wilds.name: Wild Doughnut / Launch Wild
wilds.behavior: From conveyor Launch Button; receives RPG mults.

wilds.name: xNudge Wild Tower
wilds.behavior: 4-high; nudges to bottom; mult per step additive.

wilds.name: xBomb Wild
wilds.behavior: Subs except Bonus/Red Cap; explodes adjacent President/Alphabet; +mult by value next collapse. Sticky in FS.

scatters.name: Bonus
scatters.behavior: 3→8 Covfefe; 4→10 Dog Eating. Bonus in Covfefe → +2 and upgrade remaining to Dog Eating.

multipliers.name: xBomb / RPG / xNudge
multipliers.behavior: Collapse and nudge mults; RPG 2–5× and 99×.

specials.name: Red Cap / Yellow Cap
specials.behavior: Cap Win Machine; Yellow = Max Win chance.

specials.name: xGOD
specials.behavior: Can award max win instantly in base or bonus (sheet highlight).

base_game_loop.summary: Ways cascades on 4-4-4-4-4 with Conveyor + Hot Sauce flanks. Wild Launch, xNudge Tower, xBomb, xSplit, Cap Win Machine, xGOD. 3 Bonus→8 Covfefe; 4→10 Dog Eating. Boosters 1.4×/5×/333×/6,666×. Cap 61,446×.

phases.name: Bonus / Cap check
